source: historical Steer campaign main1000_w050; R06 teacher coordinates and family-first selection retained

definition.utility: pooled decoded-final graph mean + 0.5 * observed final-tail fraction
definition.tail_fraction_denominator: All observed terminal slots in the exact-copy family, including invalid decoded offspring; valid_fraction is reported separately
definition.semantics: Observed exact-state copy-family distribution; no maximum-child reward and no native-success probability

interpretation_and_limits.selection_vs_prior: This calculator reports point/coordinate selection unchanged and changes credit/prior values only. It does not change which teacher coordinates are selected.
interpretation_and_limits.utility_units: The added tail term is a heuristic utility component, not calibrated affinity units or a measured physical quantity.
interpretation_and_limits.censoring: Unknown extinct futures remain censored. Observed offspring are Steer-conditioned; related descendants are not independent trials.
interpretation_and_limits.scope: Retrospective credit diagnostic only. No inference or efficacy claim is made.
